description: GitHub-hosted, so the hosted Renovate app runs it (the Forgejo repos inherit the h02 bot's config instead). config:best-practices pins GitHub Actions and images to digests.

packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates once EVERY check on the PR is green; majors still wait for a human. platformAutomerge is false so Renovate merges itself after reading all check results, rather than handing off to GitHub auto-merge, which waits only on branch-protection required checks (unavailable on a free-plan private repo) and so could merge a red PR. The Renovate analogue of Dependabot's documented auto-merge workflow (dependabot/fetch-metadata + gh pr merge --auto on semver-minor/patch).
Do not touch requires-python in pyproject.toml (a minimum constraint, not a pin)
